decision.presentationRule: Rows take you there (page). Context actions open beside you (pane). Tools float above you (overlay).
decision.phoneRule: At <=768px an Inspect pane is destination-only, full width, with Back to its still-mounted origin.
decision.editingRule: Existing editable prose rests rendered; Edit enters editing; Done/Save exits only after acknowledged persistence. Errors and conflicts retain the draft/editor. Cancel restores the entry snapshot for atomic configuration prose.
